
------ Proof of Structure Theorem for 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters ------

------ Proof of Outer Layer (Lemma 6.2) ------

Let z be a recurrent 53/25-power-free quaternary rich word.

There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters containing no 00, 11, 22, or 33.
The longest such word has length 22.
So by permuting the letters and taking a suffix if necessary, we may assume that z has prefix 001.

There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix 001 containing no permutation of one of w_1,w_2,...w_7.
The longest such word has length 1951.
So by permuting the letters and taking a suffix if necessary, we may assume that z has prefix w_i for some i=1,2,...,7.
------ i=1 ------

Checking that if z has prefix w_1=0010011001002, then z contains some permutation of pihat_1(5)=00100110010020010011001002232233223220223223322322002232233223220223223322322001002232233223220223223322322002232233223220223223322322.
There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix w_1 containing no permutation of pihat_1(5).
The longest such word has length 26290.
So if z contains w_1, then by permuting the letters if necessary, we may assume that z contains pihat_1(5).

------ i=2 ------

Checking that if z has prefix w_2=010010110100102, then z contains some permutation of pihat_2(5)=0100101101001020100101101001023223233232232023223233232232010232232332322320232232332322320100102322323323223202322323323223201023223233232232023223233232232.
There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix w_2 containing no permutation of pihat_2(5).
The longest such word has length 6883.
So if z contains w_2, then by permuting the letters if necessary, we may assume that z contains pihat_2(5).

------ i=3 ------

Checking that if z has prefix w_3=01011010010110102, then z contains some permutation of pihat_3(5)=01011010010110102010110100101101023233232232332320232332322323323201023233232232332320232332322323323201011010232332322323323202323323223233232010232332322323323202323323223233232.
There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix w_3 containing no permutation of pihat_3(5).
The longest such word has length 7959.
So if z contains w_3, then by permuting the letters if necessary, we may assume that z contains pihat_3(5).

------ i=4 ------

Checking that if z has prefix w_4=011001102, then z contains some permutation of pihat_4(5).
There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix w_4 containing no permutation of pihat_4(5).
The longest such word has length 74978.
So if z contains w_4, then by permuting the letters if necessary, we may assume that z contains pihat_4(5).

------ i=5 ------

Checking that if z has prefix w_5=0101101022, then z contains some permutation of pihat_5(5).
There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix w_5 containing no permutation of pihat_5(5).
The longest such word has length 24253.
So if z contains w_5, then by permuting the letters if necessary, we may assume that z contains pihat_5(5).

------ i=6 ------

Checking that if z has prefix w_6=00101101002, then z contains some permutation of pihat_6(5).
There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix w_6 containing no permutation of pihat_6(5).
The longest such word has length 36772.
So if z contains w_6, then by permuting the letters if necessary, we may assume that z contains pihat_6(5).

------ i=7 ------

Checking that if z has prefix w_7=0101100110102, then z contains some permutation of pihat_7(5).
There are only finitely many 53/25-power-free rich words over 4 letters with prefix w_7 containing no permutation of pihat_7(5).
The longest such word has length 45458.
So if z contains w_7, then by permuting the letters if necessary, we may assume that z contains pihat_7(5).


By the initial backtracking search, we may assume that z contains pihat_i(5) for some i=1,2,...,7.

------ i=1 ------

Checking that if z contains pihat_1(5), then return words to the marker 0010011001002001001100100 in z are exactly the blocks of pihat_1.

By a backtracking search for complete returns to the marker in z compatible with pihat_1(5), the only possible return words to the marker in z are the following:
['001001100100200100110010022', '001001100100200100110010022322', '0010011001002001001100100223223322322', '00100110010020010011001002232233223220223223322322', '00100110010020010011001002232233223220223223322322002232233223220223223322322', '00100110010020010011001002232233223220223223322322002232233223220223223322322001002232233223220223223322322002232233223220223223322322', '001001100100200100110010022322332232202232233223220022322332232202232233223220010022322332232202232233223220022322332232202232233223220010011001002232233223220223223322322002232233223220223223322322001002232233223220223223322322002232233223220223223322322']

------ Outer Layer (Lemma 6.2) confirmed!  We have z=pihat_i(x) for some i in {1,2,....,7} and some infinite word x. ------

Total time taken for outer layers: 63536.05793595314


------ Proof of Inner Layers (Lemma 6.3) ------

------ i=1 ------

Consider a recurrent word x such that phi^4(x) is rich and x contains no 53/25-persistent bookended repetition with respect to phi and pi_hat.

We see that x contains 0, as the longest word with no 0 whose image under phi^4 is rich and which contains no 53/25-persistent bookended repetition with respect to phi and pi_hat has length 3.
The largest tipping point of a 53/25-persistent repetition encountered in this search was 43.

By a backtracking search for complete returns to 0 in x, the only possible return words to 0 in x are the following:
['01', '0121', '0131', '0141', '0151', '0161', '02', '0232', '0242', '0252', '0262', '03', '0343', '0353', '0363', '04', '0454', '0464', '05', '0565', '06', '066']

------ Inner Layers confirmed for i=4! ------

------ i=5 ------

Consider a recurrent word x such that phi^4(x) is rich and x contains no 53/25-persistent bookended repetition with respect to phi and pi_hat.

We see that x contains 0, as the longest word with no 0 whose image under phi^4 is rich and which contains no 53/25-persistent bookended repetition with respect to phi and pi_hat has length 3.
The largest tipping point of a 53/25-persistent repetition encountered in this search was 43.

By a backtracking search for complete returns to 0 in x, the only possible return words to 0 in x are the following:
